products.title: Marlowe & Finch MF-40 Stereo Tube Amplifier
products.summary: A classic 40-watt-per-channel push-pull tube amp, recapped and fitted with new output tubes.
products.workingCondition: Fully working. Tested on the bench and in our listening room.
products.cosmeticNotes: Light wear to the faceplate lettering and some pitting on the transformer covers. One small scuff on the left handle.

children.text: The MF-40 is the amplifier many people picture when they think of British tube hi-fi: two big meters, chrome transformers and a tone that flatters almost any speaker.
Forty watts per channel is enough for most efficient and moderately efficient speakers, and it runs cool enough to live in a living room.

products.serviceNotes: Power supply rebuilt with new filter capacitors in September 2026. All coupling capacitors replaced. Bias checked and set to factory spec.
products.tubeNotes: New matched quad of current-production EL34 output tubes. Driver tubes test strong.
products.ownershipHistory: Second owner; bought new by a local collector in 1964.
products.soundCharacter: Rich midrange, relaxed treble, surprisingly firm bass.
products.connections: RCA inputs, screw terminals for 4, 8 and 16 ohm speakers, captive power cord.

infoPages.title: About Rossweisse Audio
infoPages.summary: Who we are and how we choose the gear we sell.

children.text: Rossweisse Audio is a small hi-fi shop for people who love listening. We buy, service and sell vintage and modern audio equipment, and we only list pieces we would be happy to own ourselves.
Every piece is tested on the bench and in our listening room before it goes on the site. If something is not right, we fix it or we do not sell it.
Visit us
Our showroom is open by appointment, so we can give you our full attention and a proper listen.
Get in touch
to book a time.

infoPages.title: Our Testing Process
infoPages.summary: What happens to every piece before it is listed.

children.text: Each component goes through the same steps before we list it:
Inspection.
We open it up and look for heat damage, leaking or bulging capacitors and previous repairs.
Safe power-up.
Vintage gear is brought up slowly on a variable supply while we watch the critical voltages.
Bench measurements.
Output power, distortion, channel balance and noise are checked against the original specifications.
Service.
Worn parts are replaced, controls are cleaned and anything out of spec is repaired.
Listening.
Finally, it plays music in our listening room for several hours.
What we found and what we replaced is written in each listing under
Service notes

infoPages.title: Our Rating Scale
infoPages.summary: How we grade cosmetic condition, from New to For parts only.

children.text: The condition grade on each listing describes how the piece
looks
. How it
works
is described separately under Working condition, and everything we sell works unless the listing clearly says otherwise.
Our scale follows the 1-to-10 convention common in the used hi-fi world. We grade conservatively: if we are unsure between two grades, we choose the lower one.
New:
factory sealed, with full manufacturer warranty.
New old stock (NOS):
never used, but made years or decades ago.
10 · Mint:
no signs of use at all, usually open-box.
9 · Excellent:
looks new on close inspection; at most a faint mark where it sat.
8 · Very good:
a clean faceplate and one or two minor marks elsewhere.
7 · Good:
a few light scratches or light wear on knobs and switches.
6 · Fair:
several scratches or one obvious mark; still presents well.
5 · Average:
visible wear, including on the front panel.
4 · Worn:
rough cosmetics, but everything works.
3 · Rough:
heavy wear, possibly a missing knob or cover.
2 · Very rough:
damaged parts; sold mainly for restoration.
1 · For parts only:
not working; sold as-is for parts.
Photos show every mark we mention. If you would like more pictures, just ask.

infoPages.title: Warranty & Returns
infoPages.summary: What we promise, and what happens if something goes wrong.

children.text: Pre-owned pieces come with our 90-day warranty covering parts and labor. New pieces carry the full manufacturer warranty.
If a piece arrives damaged or does not match its description, contact us within 7 days and we will make it right: a repair, a replacement or a refund.
This is sample policy text for the demo. The shop will publish its real terms before launch.

infoPages.title: Shipping & Pickup
infoPages.summary: How we pack, ship and hand over your gear.

children.text: Electronics are double-boxed with custom foam and fully insured. Speakers and very heavy pieces ship by freight or can be picked up at the showroom; their listings say so.
Local pickup is always free. Bring a blanket for the drive home.

infoPages.title: Consignment
infoPages.summary: Let us sell your gear for you.

children.text: If you would rather not deal with buyers yourself, we can sell your equipment on consignment. We test, photograph and list it, handle every question and ship it safely.
We agree the asking price together, and you are paid once the buyer has received the piece and is happy with it.
Tell us about your gear
to get started.

infoPages.title: Contact
infoPages.summary: Call, email or book a listening appointment.

children.text: The quickest way to reach us is by phone or email. Questions about a particular piece? Use the
Ask about this piece
button on its page so we know exactly which one you mean.
Thinking about a whole system? Try our
system help
form.
